title: ExplainerListOutput
description: Every explainer video the caller owns and what each one has so far. Shape ported from the reference implementation, minus the workspace path and the installed flag: both describe the server's own disk, which a hosted backend must not expose and a local one does not need to repeat.

videos.description: One entry per video, ordered by slug.

has_narration.description: Whether timings.json exists, which is what explainer_render requires.

mp4.description: Where the MP4 can be fetched. Present only when rendered is true.

size_mb.description: MP4 size in megabytes, rounded to one decimal. Present only when rendered is true.

seconds.description: Narration length in seconds, rounded to one decimal. Present only when has_narration is true.
